svg.title: Noql Free Trader - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 184-185, PDF 185-186. Upper-deck exterior plus illustration preserves long spear nose, small forward hooked fins, wide swept rear wings and upturned wing tips. Lower rectangular cargo deck is contained within the aft central body when aligned by grid and stern; exact vertical placement inferred from illustration. Fine turrets and interior room boundaries excluded; hook details simplified for tokens.
